title: Plan mode refuses every bash command, including read-only ones
observed: The model's first planning step, cat SPEC.md && ls -la, was refused: 'plan mode is read-only, so bash is not available'. Claude Code allows read-only commands while planning.
expected: Decision needed: allow read-only bash in plan mode (needs a conservative read-only classifier) or ask instead of refusing.

fix.note: Verified in the kiln-3 CRUD-trial rerun: 7.9 min, 0 prompts, $1.96 (Claude Code $2.70), 34/34 grade.
